title: Abbas aa jaao bhaayi akeilaa hai
body:
Abbas aa jaao bhaayi akeilaa hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Maqtal mein pahoonchay jab Shaahey walaa
Laashey jawaan aur khaimon ko dekha
Darya ko dekha phir yeh pukaara
Ab yeh salaam-e-aakhir hai mera
<<MINI>>
Abbas aa jaao bhaayi akeilaa hai
Tanha musaafir ko laakhon ney gheiraa hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Tumney na dekhi ghurbath humaari
Zainab thi laayi meri sawaari
Ruqsath ka meri manzar ajab thaa
Seenay sey lag jaoo bhaayi akeilaa hai.
<<MINI>>
Abbas aa jaao bhaayi akeilaa hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab sey ho bichddey Abbas hum sey
Ahley haram hain liptay Alam sey
Kaisey jiyegi baali Sakina
Kya hoga bathlaoo bhaayi akeilaa hai.
<<MINI>>
Abbas aa jaao bhaayi akeilaa hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Lashkar kahaan ka jab tum nahin ho
Aada toh khush hain ab tum nahin ho
Kitna akeilaa kitna hoon tanhaa
Seenay mein hai ghaao bhaayi akeilaa hai.
<<MINI>>
Abbas aa jaao bhaayi akeilaa hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Din bhar utthaye kitnay janaazey
Ab kaun hai jo deiga dilaasey
Hothay agar tum dethay dilaasa
Aao chaley aao bhaayi akeilaa hai.
<<MINI>>
Abbas aa jaao bhaayi akeilaa hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Mujhpar barastey yeh sang dekho
Bekas ki tanhaa ki jung dekho
Dekho na tootey Naana sey waada
Himmat badaa jaoo bhaayi akeilaa hai.
<<MINI>>
Abbas aa jaao bhaayi akeilaa hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab shimr khanjar ko pheirtaa tha
Qaatil ney Shah sey khud yeh suna tha
Pyaasa galaa us dum yeh pukaara
Soorath dikha jaoo bhaayi akeilaa hai.
<<MINI>>
Abbas aa jaao bhaayi akeilaa hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar Sheh ka aaya nokay sinaa par
Aayi sadaa yeh Rehan-o-Sarwar
Bey sar padaa hai bhaayi ka laasha
Ab toh chalay aao bhaayi akeilaa hai.
<<MINI>>
Abbas aa jaao bhaayi akeilaa hai
